• Noel-Williams remanded in custody by police

  • Charges also include count of assault by penetration

A League Two footballer has been charged with three counts of rape and remanded in custody by Hertfordshire police.

Isiah Noel-Williams, 23, who has made seven league appearances for Barnet this season, was also charged with one count of assault by penetration, one count of engaging in sexual communication with a child and one count of supplying a class B drug.
